title: Moving Money Between Your Rho-Bank Accounts
summary: Explains how to move money between your own Rho-Bank accounts via the Rho-Bank mobile app or online banking at rhobank.com (instant transfers, 24/7), or by calling 1-800-RHO-BANK / in-app chat for assistance. Internal transfers are always free; source/destination must be open in good standing and the source must have sufficient funds.
faqs: How can I transfer money between my own Rho-Bank accounts using the mobile app or online banking?
